## The status badge

Each conjecture carries one badge summarizing where it stands — a deterministic function of six fields tracked in the page's `status:` frontmatter, never hand-picked. See the [status badge legend](status-legend/index.qmd) for what each symbol means and how to update one.

## LaTeX templates

Writing up a new conjecture? [Download the LaTeX templates](latex-templates/index.qmd) — two small classes carrying the Conjura house style, plus an empty statement and solution built on them, so a new write-up doesn't have to re-derive the preamble.
